title: Fresh blind high-resolution B14 dynamic prescribed-head representation discriminator
scientific_question: On fresh B14 dynamic prescribed-head histories, which lower-zone-focused Layer-ROM representations remain competitive with high-resolution Richards controls for groundwater response and profile fidelity when Reference numerical resolution is explicit?

finest_available_control.interpretation: Finest available numerical control, not continuum truth.

temporal_control.purpose: Quantify finest-grid T8-to-T16 numerical temporal difference on the same fresh histories.

reference_design.numerical_policy: exact pre-existing D13 integrated-water-depth Reference policy used by C5I/C5L
reference_design.profile_output: 16 fixed 10-cm water-content bins emitted only at the 0.0008-day observation windows

representations.candidate_dt_authority: C5B showed R16 CURRENT_LAYER_FACE time-refinement effect negligible relative to its then-current residual; C5N retains the already-qualified diagnostic dt without response tuning.

metric_views.profile: groundwater view plus mapped_theta_rmse across 16 fixed 10-cm bins
metric_views.rationale: Per-history signed bias replaces the C5A pooled-bias gate so cancellation cannot create an artificially strong comparator. Pooled bias is retained only as a diagnostic.

spatial_frontiers.R512: Candidate is componentwise no worse than R512_T16 relative to R2048_T16 on the declared view.
spatial_frontiers.R1024: Candidate is componentwise no worse than R1024_T16 relative to R2048_T16 on the declared view.

temporal_floor.rule: Report whether candidate is componentwise no worse than R2048_T8 relative to R2048_T16. This means numerically indistinguishable from the tested finest-grid temporal refinement on that view; it is not application acceptance.

reference_quality_interpretation.if_R2048_T8_T16_exceeds_R1024_T16_R2048_: Reference temporal uncertainty is not subdominant to the strong spatial comparator; preserve candidate metrics but do not interpret an R1024-relative representation frontier as a high-resolution state-sufficiency result.
reference_quality_interpretation.otherwise: R1024-relative crossing may be interpreted as high-resolution comparator-relative representation evidence, still not continuum or application acceptance.

hypotheses.H_PLACEMENT_R4: R4 is no worse than U4 on the declared groundwater view.
hypotheses.H_PLACEMENT_R8: R8 is no worse than U8 on the declared groundwater view.
hypotheses.H_REDUCED_MEMBER_CROSSES_R512_GW: At least one reduced lower-zone ladder member crosses R512 on groundwater view.
hypotheses.H_REDUCED_MEMBER_CROSSES_R1024_GW: At least one reduced lower-zone ladder member crosses R1024 on groundwater view.
hypotheses.H_PROFILE_REQUIRES_MORE_STATE: Minimum lower-zone dimension crossing the same high-resolution comparator is larger for profile than groundwater view, when both minima exist.

stop_rules: No C5A gate or threshold is reused.
No post-response partition, history, metric or comparator tuning.
No boundary counterfactual and no production Reference change.
No application acceptance, speedup or production-ROM claim.
If no reduced member crosses R1024 but some cross R512, report the bounded comparator-strength frontier rather than inventing a tolerance.
If no reduced member crosses either high-resolution spatial comparator, close with no demonstrated high-resolution reduced frontier for this workload.
If Reference temporal quality gate is not sufficient, stop at continuous candidate errors plus Reference-quality blocker.

execution_plan.stage1: Generate and qualify fresh R512_T16, R1024_T16, R2048_T16 and R2048_T8 Reference controls before analyzing LARE candidates.
execution_plan.stage2: Only after Reference qualification, execute frozen LARE ladder and placement controls against R2048_T16.
execution_plan.execution_partition: Reference routes may be split by history and compiler optimization as execution topology only.

implementation_binding.allowed_new_code: fresh-history Reference materialization, 10-cm profile diagnostics, history-sliced execution, and preregistered comparator-relative analysis
implementation_binding.prohibited_new_code: response-driven history/partition/metric/comparator changes, closure tuning, boundary counterfactuals, production Reference edits
